summary: Ordinary trunk file writes remain deliberately unguarded by Concord. Managed-worker admission may enforce the lane capability registry against tool identities before execution, including editors and shell tools, without inspecting write destinations or restricting unmanaged host work. This is not a filesystem sandbox. Grant-level main-checkout refusal, the one-active-worktree-per-Project refusal, and Git-fact reclamation retain their existing authority.
title: File-write trunk protection is accepted as unguarded
